Admissions and Application
Begin Application
Apply here for master's and doctoral programs (see all programs here). Before beginning an application, please review the admissions requirements of the program(s) to which you are applying. Read more here about qualifying for an application fee waiver. Questions? Contact us.
Other application options
NON-DEGREE GRADUATE STUDIES (COURSES AND CERTIFICATES)
Not interested in earning a degree, but interested in taking classes from us?
Please follow the application procedures for the campus where you want to enroll:
Are you enrolled in a degree program (undergraduate or graduate) anywhere
in the CU system? If so, you are not a non-degree student.
CU Denver Non-Degree Information
CU Anschutz Non-Degree Information
CONTINUING NON-DEGREE GRADUATE STUDENTS
Are you an active non-degree graduate student from CU Denver?
Please register for your CU Denver classes through UCDAccess.
To enroll in a class not at CU Denver, please contact the Graduate School for further instructions.
Are you an active non-degree graduate student from CU Anschutz?
Follow these instructions to enroll in classes on CU Anschutz.
To enroll in a class not at CU Anschutz, please contact the Registrar's Office for further instructions.
APPLICATION FOR A PROFESSIONAL DEGREE (HEALTH PROFESSIONS)
Are you planning to apply to a professional program (DNP, MD, DPT, Public Health, etc)?
Please visit their sites to learn more about their programs and how to apply.
School of Medicine (MD, DPT, Physician Assistant, and Anesthesiology Assistant)
School of Dental Medicine (DDS)
College of Nursing (DNP, MS, PhD)
Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences (PharmD)
Colorado School of Public Health (MS, PhD, MPH, DrPH)
APPLICATION FOR AN UNDERGRADUATE DEGREE (BACHELORS)
Are you looking for the undergraduate application (BA, BS)? Please apply though Undergraduate Admissions.
General Admissions Information
The graduate admissions process is unique to each program. You apply directly to the program you are considering and the program will guide and assist you with completing the application requirements and notify you of your admission status.
Though application requirements vary according to the program of study you have selected, all applicants must submit:
An online application for admission
The application fee ($50 domestic, $75 international)
One official transcript from each college or university you have attended, regardless of whether you earned a degree
Electronic Transcripts should be sent to: [email protected]
If sending a physical transcript, please mail to:
Graduate School
Mail Stop C296
Fitzsimons Building, C5000
13001 E. 17th Place
Aurora, CO 80045
Be sure to check individual program‌ application requirements and deadlines‌. Programs may have additional admission requirements such as letters of recommendation, standardized test scores, a statement of purpose, essays, vita or resume, and/or a creative portfolio.
Are you applying to a CU Denver program? Visit the CU Denver Graduate Admissions page for more information about requirements.
International Admissions Information
Important changes to credential evaluation for CU Denver Applicants
As of July 1, 2022, CU Denver programs will require international applicants to have their international academic credentials evaluated by Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE).
Learn more about Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE)
The University of Colorado Anschutz is a fully accredited institution that offers academic excellence and unparalleled career outcomes in one of America's greatest cities. International students from 130 countries benefit from opportunities for scholarships, on-campus employment, and STEM-OPT eligible programs.
Learn more about admissions requirements for international applicants.
